question: Which values must persist with a document and which belong to transient view or application state?
trigger: The owner asked for a best-api-review audit of every open ledger unit, frozen from status at fe0e9599a6 on 2026-10-04 (39 units), and judged afresh because earlier verdicts came from a weaker model. It asked for verdicts only, so no plan, build or panel follows in this run. This scope was open as pursue-not-adopted at queue position 4 in the plite-core group. It is not the unit next returned, which was reads.
requirements: Document-associated values keep explicit persistence, history and collaboration policy with typed transitions.
Application data stored with the document lives in meta; the top level stays children, meta and roots.
Transient application or view UI stays with its product or mounted-view owner.
A derived-state runtime owner needs a current consumer; tests alone do not justify one.
evidenceReuse: Reused the 09-11 facet census and lane comparison. Rechecked on the live tree that facet symbols are absent, field definition and meta persistence, every stateFields consumer, and the cuts plan's open gates. Treated the plite-core group (runtime and schema reviewed Stop) as context for one document runtime and flat plugin composition. No tests were run.
summary: The job is to decide which values persist with a document and which stay transient. Although the ledger has no bound execution, the plite-core-cuts plan removed facets, and the live tree has no defineFacet, EditorFacet or facetProviders. defineStateField compiles a field with its transition effect, persisted fields encode and decode through document.meta (unknown meta keys pass through unchanged), and no competing meta writer exists. Real consumers span lifetimes, namely authored review state, Copilot's local history-tracked suggestion, and shared persisted title, spellcheck and page settings in examples. The strongest deletion, raw meta reads and writes without fields, would lose typed codecs, history and collaboration policy and the transition effects those consumers use. Moving fields into Plate stores would lose persistence and undo, so keep the current design.

reconciliation.question: Which values must persist with a document and which belong to transient view or application state?
reconciliation.reason: Its facet removal is adopted in the live tree through the plite-core-cuts plan; nothing materially better remains, so the verdict becomes Stop.

alternatives: Keeping fields, effects and meta persistence is selected. Each has a current consumer and one persisted truth.
Deleting fields in favor of raw meta writes is rejected. It loses typed codecs, history and collaboration policy and the transition effects authored and Copilot state use.
Merging fields into Plate's scoped plugin store is rejected, because editor-session configuration cannot persist with the document or replay through history.
Reintroducing a derived-state graph (facets) is rejected. It had no consumer, and its removal is adopted.
Encoding metadata as hidden document nodes is rejected, because it pollutes the content grammar.
proofLimits: Source review only; no tests were run. The cuts plan's strict React, runner-contract, size-snapshot and browser-matrix gates remain open for shared-checkout reasons. Top-level meta admission in document-shape.ts is uncommitted work by another session and is not relied on beyond the VISION law.
